appraisal_events.evidence: Madame de Sévigné est une grande artiste de la même famille qu'un peintre que j'allais rencontrer à Balbec et qui eut une influence si profonde sur ma vision des choses, Elstir.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator retrospectively singles Elstir out as a great artist of profound influence on his own vision, placing him in the same rank as Sévigné's genius.

status_effects.explanation: Elstir is locally elevated as a major artistic authority whose method the narrator later recognized as shaping his own perception.
